title: Unit 408 — three bedroom directions (J, K, L)
overview: Three new, fully sourced directions for Isah and Ivan, distinct from the six rejected A/B/C schemes: D low timber with paper light and terracotta; E ivory curves with caramel and thin black; F dark timber and leather-look with green velvet-tone textiles and brass. Every visible piece is a real catalogue product; technical essentials stay common by agreement.
requirements: MANDATORY: finished 50 mm mattress, 72 × 78 inches (1828.8 × 1981.2 mm), on continuous flat support with no exposed slats or gaps. No thick mattress, topper or box spring.
All prices assume new purchases. Three distinct sets of visible furniture, bedside lamps, fixtures, mirrors, rugs, textiles, plants and decor. Matching bedside pairs within each design.
Closed practical bedside storage, armrests on every chair, compact console with sourced decor. No extra generic styling objects.
75-inch wall TV baseline; 65-inch minimum, 85-inch optional pending price and clearance checks. 65-inch reference saves ₱12,000 in merchandise before contingency.
Split AC at the window-side corner of the TV wall, with airflow directed away from sleepers. Installer must verify location and capacity.
Mirror on the wall return between the two perpendicular doors. Preserve native irregular geometry, both doors, closet and warm narrow-block parquet.
Common technical essentials are owner-approved. Existing Davies Beige blackout/voile treatment and concealed old window AC remain a fixed room requirement.
procurement_gates: No scheme is purchase-ready until the bed supplier accepts the exact 50 mm mattress and a continuous flat deck. Figaro lists a steel deck (continuity unverified); Fieche and Dylan publish no support type. King outer sizes are unpublished for Figaro and Dylan.

Prices are frozen pass-3 catalogue references (snapshot 20 Oct 2026, 23:14–23:17 Manila) with each line's own price date; beds and soft goods were read from supplier JSON on 20 Oct 2026. Product existence and photos are verified; exact Cebu stock, address delivery and checkout totals are not.
Colour and size gates: Fieche variant "Grey" vs sand photo; MX3 console width; Agatha chair and SALTSJÖBADEN swivel footprints; E cushion-cover size; lamp and pendant socket types.
TV mount is the True Vision TV73-69F (in stock per manufacturer API); installer to confirm substrate, anchors and Samsung fixings. HAY Donut cord set is not in the catalogue (QUOTE REQUIRED).
Curtain ₱42,420 is the carried 16 October quote reference: ₱36,720 master treatment plus ₱3,800 valance and ₱1,900 sticks allocations. Remeasurement quote required.
Trade/freight/mattress/deck reserves total ₱35,000–84,000 as estimator allowances, not supplier quotations. 10 % contingency added, totals rounded up to the next ₱1,000.
Boards, measured plans and scaled product elevations are the acceptance basis. No AI room renders are included; generation/jobs.json holds optional render jobs with frozen references.

schemes.title: White Gallery
schemes.rationale: Grey diamond-tufted Gibson bed in a white room: white-painted 861 two-drawer bedsides and Amber shaker console, chalk-ivory FAGERBACKEN wing chair, white Vesper quilt and scalloped shams, six small white Jahn frames hung as a family-photo gallery, and architectural light only (Alphalux LED wash in the curtain valance + the flush KÄRRNOCKA disc, quiet white Kolya ceramic lamps). Lilac-mauve is the only colour: purple chrysanthemums, a mauve Dishan vase and a blush-mauve Malka cushion. White dominant, lilac accent, hidden light.
fit_notes: FAGERBACKEN dimensions unpublished; layout uses the 750 × 800 mm default — confirm. Gibson King outer size unpublished; fit uses the mattress envelope + 160 mm.
Nitori stand mirror 400 mm wide leans against the 690 mm door return (listed "unavailable online").

schemes.title: Stitched Oak
schemes.rationale: Our Home Geo with a box-stitched linen-look headboard in a walnut-stained frame; oak TONSTAD bedsides and a fluted Sierra oak-look console on black legs; Terni black-steel lounge chair with ivory-grey weave; black faceted Ashley mirror; Deidra black-metal lamps; a faceted silver-glass Blown pendant as the jewel; pale quilted coverlet with an ink-black cushion and black/white throw; Bodrum ivory rug with charcoal linework; a white-on-black line-mandala print; crystal-effect branches and a clear glass hurricane. Oak dominant, black line accent, crystal light.
fit_notes: TONSTAD 400 × 400 × 590 mm; Sierra console 1600 × 380 × 500 mm; Terni 650 × 800 mm.
Geo King outer size unpublished; drawers along the sides and foot: keep 600 mm clear at the foot for drawer pull.
Ashley faceted mirror 457 mm wide on the 690 mm return.

schemes.title: Flax Wine
schemes.rationale: Our Home Fidel spindle bed in warm mahogany dressed in undyed faux-linen; knotty-pine PS 2026 bedsides and a white-stain (limed) HEMNES console with a light pine top; ULRIKSBERG rattan armchair; KOMPISHÄNG pine floor mirror; Alphalux cane-webbing table lamps and a wide rattan NARRKOLV dome; striped jute TIOKRONA rug; Mo's Crib woven wall art; wine as the accent in a Bubble Wool cushion, a burgundy peony bunch and an ombré wine-glass vase; a Beane woven banana-leaf basket. Flax dominant, wine accent, woven light.
fit_notes: PS 2026 bedsides only 300 mm wide (a narrow pair); HEMNES 1480 × 470 × 570 mm.
ULRIKSBERG 670 × 740 mm in the window-side corner.
KOMPISHÄNG 380 mm stand mirror against the 690 mm return. Fidel King outer size unpublished.
